scope: Extend screenshot privacy to arbitrary DOM text, generated pseudo-element text and embedded image/canvas/video/frame content using screenshot-only browser CSS. Route all production CLI screenshot outputs through the same helper. Keep the live page unchanged and preserve opaque masks for form controls and explicitly sensitive regions.

acceptance.arbitrary_visible_dom_text_hidden: PASS - pre-fix synthetic Chromium capture contained 3,242 dark pixels in the unclassified-answer region; fixed capture contained zero.
acceptance.generated_pseudo_element_text_hidden: PASS - pixel assertion found visible synthetic generated text before capture and none in the saved screenshot.
acceptance.embedded_canvas_and_image_hidden: PASS - synthetic canvas text and inline SVG image pixels were visible in the baseline and absent in the saved screenshot; DOM canvas data remained present.
acceptance.live_page_not_mutated: PASS - page text, canvas content and control state remained available after the screenshot call; privacy stylesheet is passed only to Playwright screenshot.
acceptance.known_sensitive_controls_remain_masked: PASS - existing password, demographic, data-sensitive, contenteditable, ARIA textbox and combobox pixel tests pass.
acceptance.all_product_screenshot_writers_use_helpe: PASS - source inventory found only cli/live_feedback.py calls page.screenshot; cli/ui_e2e.py and cli/ui_source_readback.py route artifacts through the same helper.
acceptance.html_snapshot_and_raw_trace_storage: PASS - no product HTML snapshot writers found in cli/apps/services/workers; live feedback tracing remains disabled and no DOM snapshot is written.

test_first_red.observation: Before the production change the assertion expected zero dark pixels but observed 3,242 in the synthetic arbitrary-text region.
